tree: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. We use cookies and similar technologies to ensure the proper functioning of our website, to remember your preferences, to measure audience performance, and, where you consent, to support analytics and advertising activities.
These cookies are necessary for the website to function. They cannot be disabled.
axeptio_cookies: Stores you cookie preferences for a duration of 6 months.
axeptio_authorized_vendors: Stores accepted vendors for a duration of 6 months.
These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website. We only use them with your consent.
Google Analytics 4: Audience measurement, navigation analysis for a duration of 13 months.
These cookies allow us to measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns. We only use them with your consent.
Google Ads: Conversion tracking, campaign performance for a duration of 90 days.
LinkedIn Insight Tag: Campaign tracking, B2B audience measurement for a duration of 30 days to 2 years.

Strictly necessary cookies are used on the basis of H Company’s legitimate interest in operating and securing the website and managing your consent preferences. Analytics and advertising cookies are used only with your prior consent.

You can accept or refuse non-essential cookies at any time by clicking on "Cookies preferences" at the bottom of the page and adjusting your preferences. Refusing cookies must be as easy as accepting them, and your choice will be respected unless you change it later. You can also manage cookies through your browser settings, although this may affect certain features of the website.
Note that disabling certain cookies may affect your experience on our site.
